eyebrow: Yubakiwe abajyanama b'ubuzima bo mu Rwanda
heroBody: ZeroMalaria ifasha umujyanama w'ubuzima gusuzuma malaria, kumenya kare ibimenyetso by'akaga no kohereza umurwayi ku kigo nderabuzima, n'iyo nta interineti ihari.
problemTitle: Urunana rucikira hagati y'umudugudu n'ikigo nderabuzima.
problem1B: Kureba ibimenyetso by'akaga bitandukana ku buri gusura.
problem2B: Urupapuro ruva mu mudugudu ntirwemezwe ko rwageze.
problem3B: Uturere tubona ubwiyongere n'ibura ry'imiti igihe cyarenze.
how1B: Ikibazo kimwe icyarimwe: imyaka, umuriro, ibimenyetso by'akaga, RDT. Bikora nta interineti.
how2B: Amategeko y'ubuvuzi ni yo agena ubwihutirwe. Umujyanama arasuzuma akemeza.
how3B: Ibaruwa y'ikoranabuhanga ifite kode QR igera ku kigo nderabuzima.
how4B: Iyo umurwayi atageze ku kigo, umujyanama arabimenyeshwa akamukurikirana.
whoChwB: Gusuzuma kuyobowe mu mudugudu, mu Kinyarwanda, n'ijwi.
whoSupB: Itsinda, abarwayi n'ikurikirana ku kigo kimwe.
whoRbcB: Ikarita, ibimenyetso by'ubwiyongere, urukurikirane rwo kohereza, ububiko.
safetyTitle: AI irafasha. Amategeko aragena. Abantu baremeza.
layer1B: Ibimenyetso by'akaga bisobanura kohereza byihutirwa. Ntibigabanywa.
layer2B: Ishobora kongera ubwihutirwa gusa, ntiyabugabanya, kandi isobanura impamvu.
layer3B: Ifasha mu magambo n'ijwi. Ntisuzuma indwara, ntivuga imiti.
voiceTitle: Ivuga Ikinyarwanda. Yumva yego cyangwa oya.
voiceBody: Ibibazo bisomwa mu ijwi bivuye mu rutonde rw'amagambo rwasuzumwe, bityo umujyanama agakomeza kureba umurwayi.
offlineBody: Buri isuzuma ribikwa neza kandi ryoherezwa ubwaryo iyo rezo igarutse.
ctaBody: Injira ukoresheje konti yatanzwe n'umuyobozi wawe.
